title: What NOT To Do When a Police Officer Shows Up
description:
On November 28, 2021, officers were dispatched to a residence after a caller advised two males had been yelling and fighting in Holmen, WI. Upon arrival, they met with one of the male’s girlfriends who was very uncooperative and refused to talk about what happened that evening. When officers attempted to check part of the residence, the female prevented them. As a result, she ended up hitting and spitting on an officer and was arrested.

An hour later, police were called to the same residence after one of the males was back and wanted to fight the other male party again. The homeowner advised police to trespass the male from her residence. As she allowed him to gather his belongings, she requested the officers to come in as well. The male didn’t exactly like that…

For business inquiries or other questions contact:
codebluecam@gmail.com

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
